data.long_meaning: Derived from two Sanskrit words, 'sri' meaning 'stream' and 'jani' meaning 'creation'. The name Srijani carries the meaning “Stream of Creation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Srijani usually hope their child will grow to embody stream of creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Srijani total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

Another reference to Srijani can be found in the 'Nalopakhyana' section of the 14th century Sanskrit epic 'Padma Purana'. Here, she is described as the goddess of fertility and the giver of children. She is also known to bestow wealth and prosperity upon her devotees.
